title: Restoration Technician
description:
Our Client provides restoration services in Bracebridge and surrounding areas. Job assignments can include specialty mitigation services, light demolition, water extraction, carpet and upholstery cleaning, mold abatement, vandalism clean-up, fire and smoke damage mitigation, content move-outs and pack-ins, and content cleaning.

Your role
  • Drive a company vehicle to site locations
  • Perform mold damage restoration, including dry-outs, packing, cleaning, debris removal, etc.
  • Maintain a clean and organized vehicle and clean equipment appearance
  • Perform end-of-the-day job cleanup and breakdown
  • Inventory and load the work vehicle with equipment, products and supplies needed for each project
  • Have empathy for others and show a sense of urgency in resolving customers' problems
  • Work hard and take pride in doing the job properly
  • Move equipment and other items from the warehouse to the job site and back
  • Communicate with management to report project status, updates, issues, or concerns
Skills
  • Must have good communication skills
  • Must have a valid Drivers License
  • Reliable transportation
  • Able to move and/or lift 50+ lbs.
  • Must have a completed background check
  • Previous restoration experience is a plus!
  • Previous construction and/or restoration experience required.
  • Previous experience working on water/fire damage jobs specifically, environmental experience, and hazardous waste is an asset
General hours of work are Monday to Friday 8 am to 5 pm with occasional emergency response work after-hours and/or on weekends. Wage to be based on experience.

We are committed to an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise Human Resources of any accommodations needed to ensure you have access to a fair and equitable process. Any information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

title: Carpenter
description:
Experienced Carpenter Wanted!


Are you a skilled carpenter who takes pride in your work? Join our clients’ team, a trusted family-run business serving Lake Rosseau and Lake Joseph. They’re hiring a full-time, experienced Carpenter to help build and renovate beautiful lakeside properties.

Why Work With Our Client?

  • Competitive wages
  • Paid holidays
  • Group benefits & life insurance after 3 months
  • Work apparel provided
  • Supportive, family-oriented team

What You’ll Do:

  • Build from the ground up – foundations to roofing
  • Read blueprints and install materials with precision
  • Work independently or with a team
  • Maintain high standards and safe practices

What We’re Looking For:

  • Min 5+ years of carpentry experience. Licensed carpenter an asset.
  • Valid driver’s license & reliable transportation
  • Own basic tools
  • Working at Heights Certificate
  • Knowledge of Muskoka building codes

📍 Work Location: Rosseau, ON

📅 Schedule: Monday to Friday 8 am to 5 pm

Ready to build something great? Apply now and become part of our Clients’ family!
